verdict: The shadow book did not lose −287.94R of trading: on 515 closed shadow trades it made +92.55R gross and paid 380.49R of modelled costs, 82% of them Kraken spot fees on 139 crypto scalps whose stops are a fraction of the 0.8% round trip (the same trades at CFD cost: +18.17R). One bookkeeping artefact is proven and repaired (29 m30m1 copies of Scalp entries, 26 closed this week, counted twice: after the repair the week is 489 trades, +73.74R gross / −303.77R net). The near-stop market fills are a sizing artefact for the owner to rule on (23 trades filled at under half the planned risk carry 85.92R of the cost). No shadow stream has robust research behind it; rscalp and the crypto legs are already judged (losing / unjudgeable on this venue) and should be retired; intraday, rintra on gold, m30m1 on its own trades and the ICT variants are the streams worth the paper.
